scope: Saved validation predictions only; no test split, labels, images, or model weights were modified.

best_verified_candidate.preprocessing: Existing page preprocessing: median3, autocontrast cutoff1, contrast1.15, max2400

normalization.whitespace: collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and trim
normalization.cer_units: Unicode code points including normalized spaces
normalization.aggregation: corpus edit distance / total reference units; denominator at least 1
normalization.failures: empty prediction for CER/WER; incorrect for exact match; all samples included

methodology.alignment: Per-sample unit-cost Levenshtein; backtrace ties: match, substitution, deletion, insertion. Minimum alignments may be ambiguous; counts describe this deterministic alignment.
methodology.indices: Zero-based input sample order and normalized character/word indices; absent edit units are null.
methodology.rates: Corpus CER/WER use total errors / max(1, total reference units), never averages of line rates. Per-line and length-bin zero-reference denominators are also max(1, reference units). Rates may exceed 1.
methodology.failures: Retained, scored as empty predictions and never exact matches, matching the baseline evaluator.
methodology.word_errors: Whitespace tokenization; case and punctuation retained. Missing/extra words are alignment deletions/insertions, not semantic diagnoses.
methodology.spelling_candidates: Alphabetic word substitutions only; both lengths >=3, casefolded strings differ, Levenshtein <=2 and <=40% of longer length. Heuristic near-spelling errors, not dictionary-verified; excludes case-only changes.
methodology.ranking: Top 20 per-line CER/WER, descending; ties by input order. Short references can yield extreme rates.
methodology.examples: One example row per input, with the complete unchanged source_record and all edit operations; multiple category tags may apply.
methodology.scope: Saved validation predictions only. No test predictions, datasets, image crops or model weights read. No tuning or causal claims about handwriting quality.
